timingMeaning: Measured CPU-side renderer/visual wall time; includes submission and driver waits, not GPU execution time. Parallel visual tasks can overlap; their summed work is not elapsed frame latency.
geometryMeaning: Observed BufferBuilder vertices and estimated vertex data; alternative rendering pipelines may bypass these counters. Not GPU uploads or VRAM.
coverageMeaning: Standard entity/block entity calls, attributed deferred Mekanism calls and Flywheel visual creation/frame/tick/update/light CPU work for real world instances. Shared Flywheel CPU batch submission is separate in phases. Instanced geometry and contraption virtual-world blocks are not attributed; totals are not the complete cost of a mod.
gpuMeaning: Full mode can display asynchronous shared Flywheel GPU timestamps in the live UI. Delayed GPU diagnostics are not included in this capture and are never assigned to individual mechanisms.
percentiles: Capture percentiles use bounded histograms; averages include frames with zero calls.

integrations.coverage: Immediate-mode native vertex-copy adapter enabled; counters show observed measured calls
Shadow pass excluded from ordinary object and shared Flywheel measurements; shader buffer RenderType requests observed separately

limitations: Terrain/chunk batches are not attributed to individual mods or world objects.
Shader execution and terrain GPU cost are not distributed among mods or individual objects.
